note: group systems is the closest existing atlas group (rates and responses); the page is chemical kinetics

title.en: Activation energy and the Arrhenius law

description.zh: 能量山、玻尔兹曼因子、k = A·e^(−Eₐ/RT)、催化剂与逆反应；最简形式，忽略取向因子与熵。
description.en: Energy hill, Boltzmann factor, k = A·e^(−Eₐ/RT), catalysts and the reverse reaction in the simplest form, ignoring orientation factors and entropy.

label.zh: 只有分布的尾部起作用
label.en: Only the tail of a distribution matters

reason.zh: 反应速率由能量分布尾部那一小部分分子决定，估计稀有事件需要大量样本。
reason.en: The rate is set by the small tail of the energy distribution, and estimating a rare event takes a very large sample.

reason.zh: 能量足够的分子比例就是一个概率 e^(−Eₐ/RT)，速率常数把这个概率乘上碰撞频率。
reason.en: The fraction of molecules with enough energy is a probability, e^(−Eₐ/RT), and the rate constant multiplies it by a collision frequency.

reason.zh: 放热反应让温度升高、速率变快，可能自我加速，是反馈的化学例子。
reason.en: An exothermic reaction warms itself and speeds up, a chemical example of positive feedback.

title.zh: 为什么升温能让反应快这么多？
title.en: Why does warming speed a reaction up so much?
